latestVersion.changelog:
Competitive Ads Extractor Pro v1.0.0

- Initial release
- Extracts ads from Facebook, LinkedIn, and other ad libraries for selected competitors
- Analyzes messaging, use cases, pain points, and creative patterns in competitor ads
- Categorizes ads by theme, format, and audience; identifies common successful approaches
- Saves visual screenshots for reference
- Provides actionable insights and recommendations to improve your own ad campaigns
